legitimate_readings.label: A and B are one thing; C is another
legitimate_readings.why: A and B rest on a common baseline and C sits elsewhere in the frame. Position is the only evidence here and it is sufficient.

ambiguity.note: All three are identical discs, so anything reasoning from appearance will group all three. The ambiguity is not in the picture; it is in which evidence you privilege.

grounds.detail: A and B share a baseline; C does not
identical in all three — evidence AGAINST using appearance here, recorded so the score can show a producer that used it anyway

utility_verdicts.why: the grouping is what a person would act on, and the grounds say what it rests on.

notes: The appearance ground is recorded with strength 0.0 rather than omitted. A ground that was considered and rejected is evidence about the reasoning; a ground that is simply absent is silence, and the two look identical in a score that only counts grounds.
